Kuzmyn Jewish Cemetery (Krasyliv District)

Jewish Cemetery · Khmelnytskyi Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. This record shares population statistics nearly identical to the separately documented Kuzmyn Jewish Cemetery in the Horodok District elsewhere in this collection — both cite 641 Jews in 1847 and 830 (24.6 percent of the town) in 1897 — a duplication worth flagging as a possible data-quality issue, whether reflecting a genuinely shared history or an error in the source. This Kuzmyn's Jews were sent to Krasyliv, documented elsewhere in this collection, in February 1942 and murdered there that July.
